nd736fb9e36.headline: Slight increase in the unemployment rate in Morocco
nd736fb9e36.summary: The High Commission for Planning announced a slight increase in Morocco's unemployment rate to 10.6% in Q3 2017.
nd736fb9e36.why: Unemployment rates are key indicators of economic health and labor market conditions, influencing consumer spending and policy decisions.

n34c9fe4239.headline: VAT exemption for the smallest businesses could increase one and a half times
n34c9fe4239.summary: Hungarian Finance Minister Mihály Varga indicated the VAT exemption upper limit for smallest businesses could increase to 12 million forints.
n34c9fe4239.why: Changes to VAT exemption thresholds affect small business tax burdens and can influence entrepreneurship and economic activity in Hungary.
